findings.completed_resume: Restores used_tokens, charged_groups, imputed_unknown_tokens and included pending directories before the completed-cursor early return; regression preserves actual nonzero committed ledger and update count.
findings.crash_accounting: Durable whole-step reservation (run-binding hash, parent/cursor, step/example IDs and exact costs) precedes native work. Pending work is conservatively imputed, separately labeled, before admitting another step; exact-cap regression stops without free replay and repeated recovery does not accumulate an additional charge. Reservation is admitted to the shared atomic file inventory.
findings.finite_update_order: Each native loss and gradient norm is checked before accumulation; final summed norm must be finite and positive before optimizer.update. Actual native-method control flow with NumPy NaN stand-ins rejects without any optimizer call.
findings.image_integrity: Native expected image hashes are mandatory, checked after per-example resource callback and again after native input preparation; all step images rechecked before any updated boundary publication. Mutation regression preserves only initial checkpoint.

limitations: This verdict covers only the four reproduced defects and their corrections; it is not an executable SFT launch approval or a new review of unrelated Tier C hooks.

No native SFT gradient/model run was performed by the reviewer. Teacher-forced loss-mask numerical parity, actual native resource peak, complete source/data/target/budget/common-initializer launch scope and updated checkpoint restoration must remain explicit in a separate finite admission.
Crash accounting is conservative IMPUTED cost for unknown partial native work, not a measured token-consumption claim; imputation can end an arm early.
Successful CPU regression does not establish MRI understanding, held-out generalization, SFT/RL compute equivalence or full Vero transfer.
